objective: Prevent strategically aligned learning courses from being converted into player quests that mismatch the learner's verified baseline, prerequisites, or instruction/interface language; route the German A0 execution action to the official Russian DW surface.

roles_before.role: Owns verified current learning baseline and execution evidence, including German A0.
Supplies long-horizon learning direction without owning current competence or exact entry step.
Requires current owner evidence before scored quest creation and calibrates effort/friction/complexity/stakes.
Provides the direct player-facing execution link for the current German learning quest.
Remains the sole mutable owner of derived quest state.
Preserves at most one execution focus and does not allow engineering changes to choose unrelated strategic direction.

role_dispositions.destination: domains/learning.md remains authoritative for German A0 baseline and actual learning evidence.
XMind remains a read-only strategic prior; alignment no longer substitutes for entry-step suitability.
QUEST_DIFFICULTY_SPEC.md keeps existing scoring and will add a narrow pre-scoring learning execution-fit gate.

player-utility.js will route the current German quest action to the verified official Russian-localized DW Hallo URL instead of the English locale; this does not itself cancel, replace or resolve the quest.
Neon/PostgreSQL system_events remains the only mutable derived-state owner.
QUEST_FOCUS_SPEC.md remains unchanged; engineering does not choose a replacement quest or focus for Ron.

capability_probes.assertion: Non-learning Quest v2 selection/scoring, rewards, focus, evidence and action-gate semantics remain unchanged.

A verified strategic course/track label alone cannot justify a learning quest when current baseline, prerequisites, instruction/interface language, or concrete capability outcome is unknown or incompatible.
Zero-auth public PWA access, notifications, skills, marketplace presentation and non-learning execution actions remain intact.

tests.expected: The controller regression guard requires baseline/prerequisite/instruction-language/capability-outcome reconciliation for learning quests and rejects strategy-label-only suitability.
The current German quest exposes the verified official Russian DW Hallo URL; changing the action locale does not mutate quest lifecycle or evidence.
Existing cloud/PWA quest, projection, focus, notification and public-access behavior remains green.

known_intentional_losses: The English-localized DW action URL is retired for this Russian-first player execution path.

run_notes.finding: The candidate tail contained only the preservation manifest; implementation had not started. Current player utility still hard-codes https://learngerman.dw.com/en/hallo/l-37250531 while the learning owner confirms German A0 and the project owner records the resulting execution-fit/localization defect.
run_notes.verified_external_evidence: A fresh browser fetch resolved https://learngerman.dw.com/ru/hallo/l-37250531 as the official Russian-localized DW endpoint.
run_notes.actual_change: Reconciled this manifest so the engineering slice no longer presumes an unauthorized quest cancellation/replacement. The slice now separates safe locale correction from the user-directed player-state replacement decision.
run_notes.blocked: Direct browser edit of player-utility.js was attempted through the authenticated browser executor but rejected before a run started because strict agent mode is not enabled for the account. No runtime/code/player-state mutation was claimed.
run_notes.next_unblock: Apply the narrow code/policy/test delta through an executable repository edit path, run the declared candidate CI, review base-to-head diff, then promote only on PASS.
